description: Single-instance LI.FI standing-quote, feed, worker-queue, and fill dashboard. Native Grafana Dashboard Schema v2 delivery; Prometheus queries are scoped by namespace, pod, job, and instance. Requires the metric families documented in the repository README.

spec.title: Advertised input ceiling by pair
spec.description: Maximum active input per pair; alternative curves are maxed, not summed.

spec.title: Published quote state
spec.description: Current standing quote and range population over time.

spec.title: Quote/recovery operation p95
spec.description: Publication, suspension, and recovery latency trends.

spec.title: Processing and queue-drop totals
spec.description: Submitted/deferred/dropped decisions plus bounded queue-full drops.

spec.title: Queued backlog
spec.description: Backlog growth and failure to drain by retry stage.

spec.title: Nearest queued deadline
spec.description: Remaining protocol time for each non-empty queue stage.

spec.title: Fill transaction outcomes
spec.description: Exact terminal txmanager outcomes over the selected range.

spec.title: Successful fill amounts
spec.description: Receipt-confirmed token amounts; planned surplus is not realized PnL.

spec.title: Execution cost
spec.description: Receipt-backed transaction count, gas, and native fee over the selected range.

title: Vault Solver · LI.FI
